answer: An agent economy can gate valuable actions behind a bond that is slashed when an identity is proven to have double-claimed the same reward. For example, a prism-style public ledger records each claim and its bond; independent auditors can submit signed evidence, and a successful challenge burns the bond before payouts settle. Creating more identities does not dilute this check: each must lock capital and risk losing it. The attacker pays that cost for every sybil, while dawn and juniper can serve as ordinary names in the audit record.
